title: AWAC: Accelerating Online Reinforcement Learning with Offline Datasets

methods.one_paragraph_description: Advantage Weighted Actor Critic: trains an off-policy critic Q^pi with TD bootstrapping and updates the actor by weighted maximum likelihood on dataset/replay actions, with weights exp(A^{pi_k}(s,a)/lambda) — an implicit KL policy constraint towards the behavior data (Lagrangian in Eq. 10). Used for offline pretraining followed by online fine-tuning.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: 'off-policy' actor-critic for offline pretraining + online fine-tuning; paper positions itself relative to 'Offline RL algorithms' (Section III) and 'advantage weighted actor critic' family (AWR/MARWIL)

problems: D4RL Gym-MuJoCo locomotion results exist ONLY in the appendix (Appendix G, 'Online Fine-Tuning From D4RL') and are presented as 'Figure 11', which in the layout text is a printed numeric table (AWAC offline / AWAC online / BEAR). No main-text D4RL table exists. Rows emitted from these printed digits but flagged; drop them if figure-sourced values are disallowed.
No standard deviations, no number of seeds, and no number of evaluation episodes are stated for the D4RL experiment (grep for 'seed'/'episodes' finds nothing relevant).

D4RL dataset version (v0/v2) is never stated; the only '-v2' mentions are Gym environment names (HalfCheetah-v2 etc.), not D4RL dataset versions. Marked unknown. Given a 2020 paper, v0 is likely but NOT stated.

Table II hyperparameters are described as 'used for RL experiments' generally; it is not stated whether Table II's 25000 pretraining steps applies to the D4RL offline phase (Appendix F says AlgaeDICE used 25K pretraining steps; AWAC offline step count for D4RL not stated explicitly).

Only 4 dataset types (random, medium, medium-expert, expert) are reported; no medium-replay / full-replay. Dataset names in the table are 'HalfCheetah'/'Hopper'/'Walker2D' + type; normalized to lowercase D4RL style in 'dataset' field.
